we present a novel approach for loop closure detection that utilizes the output of the intermediate layer of the CNN as image descriptors, and we establish an acceleration method that can be applied online.

the SeqCNNSLam method is a new method of loop closure detection that is based on the outputs of the intermediate layer of pre-trained CNNs, which is more effective than the state-of-the-art loop closure detection methods, and that the A-SeqCNSSLam method can accelerate the SeqCNNSlam method while still maintaining a high detection rate.
the SeqCNNSLAMS are effective and robust in loop closure detection, and the A-SeqCNSSALM and O-SeqCNSSSLAM are effective in real-time loop closure detection.

the development of an efficient LCD approach that is robust to viewpoint and condition change.
the development of a novel LCD system that has high accuracy and satisfactory real-time performance.
